end.summary:
Aryan showed they can tell a point, line segment, line and ray apart using endpoints and arrowheads, including in a new situation.
They practised naming segments, lines and rays with letters; naming rays is still not steady and needs checking next time.
They first treated a longer line drawing as a different or longer line, then corrected this later using the arrowheads and unlimited extent.
They still treated ray AB and ray BA as the same; the one-endpoint rule was revisited, but letter order needs more checking.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised identifying points, line segments, lines and rays from endpoints and arrowheads. They used the idea that a drawing’s screen or ruler length does not change an infinite line, and corrected that mix-up later in the lesson. Ray naming and the direction in ray AB versus ray BA still need practice; at home, show two labelled rays and ask which letter marks the starting endpoint.
